physical_subject: Why does a midpoint receive weight four?
relationship: Simpson weights1,4,1 times width/6 integrate quadratics exactly; the same three-point estimate need not be exact for a quartic.
operation: Compare trapezoid and midpoint areas before combining them; a quartic demonstrates the limit of exactness.
closest_prior: Earlier fundamental theorem and area illustrations
substantive_difference: Numerical quadrature from three samples, deriving weighting from midpoint and trapezoid estimates.
